grammar_focus: KS30 冠词 a/an/the 与 some/any 综合复习(some 肯定/any 疑问否定、a/an 泛指、the 特指、the+形容词表群体、the+最高级 vs most、零冠词固定短语)(教材 L54 Key structures)主考;课文 no sooner…than、What a mess、ring back、pick up、sign for(辅考)
scene: 早饭后,我送孩子们上学,然后就去了商店。我回到家时,时间还早。孩子们在上学,我丈夫在上班,家里清静得很。于是我决定做些肉馅饼。不一会儿我就忙着调拌起了黄油和面粉,很快我的手上就沾满了粘粘的面糊。恰恰在此时,电话铃响了。没有什么能比这更烦人了。我用两个沾满面糊的手指捏起了话筒。当我听出是海伦·贝茨的声音时,非常丧气。我用了 10 分钟的时间才说服她过会儿再来电话。我终于挂上了话筒。真是糟糕透了!我的手指上、电话机上以及门的把手上,都沾上了面糊。我刚回到厨房,门铃又响了起来,响声足以把死人唤醒。这次是邮递员,他要我签收一封挂号信!

grammar_card.title: 冠词 a/an/the 与 some/any
grammar_card.intro: KS30 综合复习冠词和 some/any:some 多用于肯定句,any 多用于疑问句和否定句;a/an 泛指'一个',the 特指;the + 形容词可表'一类人'(the rich 富人、the poor 穷人);最高级前用 the,但'大多数'用 most(不加 the)。

rows: I want some. / Did you get any?
The rich should help the poor.
the + 最高级 / most 大多数

specialRules.rule: go to school / at work / go to bed 等固定短语用零冠词(表抽象概念);go to the cinema / the theater 用 the。
no sooner … than 表'刚…就…';enough 作副词修饰形容词/副词时放在其后(loud enough)。

prelisten.q: Listen and answer — What two interruptions did the writer have?
options: The telephone rang, then the doorbell rang

passage: After breakfast, I sent the children to school and then I went to the shops. It was still early when I returned home. The children were at school, my husband was at work and the house was quiet. So I decided to make some meat pies. In a short time I was busy mixing butter and flour and my hands were soon covered with sticky pastry. At exactly that moment, the telephone rang. Nothing could have been more annoying. I picked up the receiver between two sticky fingers and was dismayed when I recognized the voice of Helen Bates. It took me ten minutes to persuade her to ring back later. At last I hung up the receiver. What a mess! There was pastry on my fingers, on the telephone, and on the doorknobs. I had no sooner got back to the kitchen than the doorbell rang loud enough to wake the dead. This time it was the postman and he wanted me to sign for a registered letter!

stage5.stem: "I want ___ information about the trip."(肯定句里表'一些')
stage5.stem_cn: 我想要一些有关旅行的信息。

stage5.stem: "Did you get ___ information?"(疑问句里表'任何、什么')
"There isn't ___ news in the paper today."(否定句里表'任何')
"I did ___ work before breakfast."(肯定句里表'一些')
"We need ___ new cinema in our town."(泛指一座,用不定冠词)
stage5.stem_cn: 我们镇需要一座新电影院。

stage5.stem: "He is ___ honest man."(honest 的 h 不发音,首音是元音)
"In ___ short time I was busy mixing butter and flour."(泛指一段短时间的不定冠词)
stage5.stem_cn: 不一会儿我就忙着拌黄油和面粉。

stage5.stem: "___ school in our village was built last year."(特指本村那所学校的定冠词)
stage5.stem_cn: 我们村的那所学校是去年建的。

stage5.stem: "The rich should help ___ poor."(在形容词 poor 前加冠词表'穷人'这一类人)
"There are organizations to help the deaf and ___ blind."(在形容词 blind 前加冠词表'盲人'这一类人)
stage5.stem_cn: 有些组织帮助聋人和盲人。

stage5.stem: "The children went to ___ early this morning."(上学·表抽象概念,用零冠词)
"I often go to ___ at weekends."(去看电影这个习惯说法,cinema 前加定冠词)
"My husband was at ___."(在上班·固定短语,用零冠词)
"It is ___ most interesting exhibition I have ever seen."(最高级 most interesting 前加的定冠词)
stage5.stem_cn: 这是我看过的最有趣的展览。

stage5.stem: "___ people enjoyed the film."(表'大多数人',直接用这个词、不加冠词)
stage5.stem_cn: 大多数人喜欢这部电影。

stage5.stem: "I had no sooner got back to the kitchen ___ the doorbell rang."(表'刚一…就…'的固定结构后半)
stage5.stem_cn: 我刚回到厨房,门铃就响了。

stage5.stem: "What a ___! There was pastry everywhere."(表'真是一团糟、真狼狈')
stage5.stem_cn: 真是一团糟!到处都是面糊。

stage5.stem: "It took ten minutes to persuade her to ring ___ later."(晚点再回电话)
stage5.stem_cn: 花了十分钟才说服她晚点再打来。
